loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (mean) has a higher overall score and a larger gap to the best, with a noticeably higher error in the first window, suggesting sensitivity to model ranking changes. Candidate B (dba) also has a higher overall score and a more variable per‑window performance; its DTW barycenter may over‑smooth the strong trend, leading to poorer accuracy in the early window. Both are therefore less suitable than the robust median for this series.
